title: Docker Compose: several services, dependencies and a single command

videos.script: Shelf with a real database is two containers. They have to find each other, start in the right order, and keep their data. {{hand}} By hand, that is a network, two long commands, and a race. Shelf started before Postgres was ready, and gave up. {{file}} Compose writes all of it in one file. Two services, a volume, a secret, and one line that waits for the database to be healthy. {{up}} Then one command brings it up, in the right order, every time. {{daily}} And the commands of an ordinary day: exec, logs, a rebuild that leaves the database alone, and the difference between down, which keeps the data, and down dash v, which does not.
